visualCharacteristics.purpose: Location context bar ("Products & pricing based on your address | Change") with an inline ZIP code form; lead-form option renders a "have us call you" lead capture form

contentPattern.structure: Default: row 1 = message | change trigger (text or link) | optional help; optional key/value rows ZIP label, Update label, Cancel label, Storage key. lead-form: intro row (headings/text), field rows Label | type (text, tel, email, number, zip, textarea, select) | name | placeholder [| select options], consent/disclosure text rows, submit row Label | submit, optional key/value rows Action (endpoint URL), Success, Error

usage: Top-of-page pricing location bar on banking and small-business pages; lead form on mortgage / home equity pages
reuseGuidance: Use lead-form for any short contact-request form; set an Action row to post submissions, otherwise the form only validates and shows the success message.
